{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the number of unique sites
print(f"Number of unique sites: {df['site'].nunique()}")

# Compute response rate per site
response_rates = df.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()

# Check the response rates
response_rates_sorted = response_rates.sort_values(ascending=False)
print("Response rates by site (sorted):")
print(response_rates_sorted)

# Get the site with the highest response rate
best_site = response_rates_sorted.index[0]
best_rate = response_rates_sorted.iloc[0]

print(f"Site with highest response rate: {best_site} ({best_rate:.3f})")"}
